claims.claim: Cells are living units with a membrane that regulates exchange and internal machinery that performs functions. Specialised cells form tissues; tissues combine into organs and organs into systems. Epithelial tissue lines surfaces, connective tissue supports and connects, muscle tissue contracts, and nervous tissue communicates. An organ typically contains multiple tissue types. Anatomy describes structures; physiology describes functions. The distinction helps explain why a change in tissue structure may affect an organ's performance.
